source.author: verg
source.text: Una omnes ruere, ac totum spumare reductis convolsum remis rostrisque tridentibus aequor.
source.text_original: Una omnes ruere, ac totum spumare reductis / convolsum remis rostrisque tridentibus aequor.
source.text_english: All together they rush, and the whole sea boils, torn up by the withdrawn oars and by the triple-pronged beaks.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: una omnes gaudent superi, venturaque mundo tempora aquaeque vias cernunt sibi crescere Parcae.
reuse.text_original: una omnes gaudent superi, venturaque mundo / tempora aquaeque vias cernunt sibi crescere Parcae.
reuse.text_english: All the gods above rejoice together, and they see the coming times for the world and the Fates see their own paths of action growing.
